title: Sable and the Hollow
author: Yara Blackwood
blurb: Marguerite Ishikawa, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
